subject: Chemistry
question_text: The ratio of mass percentage (w/w) of carbon to hydrogen in a hydrocarbon is 12:1. It has two carbon atoms. The weight (in g) of CO₂ formed when 3.38 g of this hydrocarbon is completely burnt in oxygen is (C=12, H=1, O=16):
solution: A carbon-to-hydrogen mass ratio of 12:1 with two carbon atoms gives C₂H₂ (molar mass 26 g mol⁻¹). Moles of C₂H₂ = 3.38/26 = 0.13 mol, producing 2×0.13=0.26 mol CO₂. Mass CO₂=0.26×44=11.44 g. Option B.

subject: Chemistry
question_text: The first and second ionization constants of a weak dibasic acid H₂A are 8.1×10⁻⁸ and 1.0×10⁻¹³, respectively. 0.1 mol of H₂A is dissolved in 1 L of 0.1 M HCl solution. The concentration of HA⁻ in the resultant solution is:
solution: The strong acid fixes [H⁺]≈0.1 M and the formal concentration of H₂A is 0.1 M. For H₂A ⇌ H⁺+HA⁻, Ka1=[H⁺][HA⁻]/[H₂A], so [HA⁻]≈Ka1[H₂A]/[H⁺]=8.1×10⁻⁸×0.1/0.1=8.1×10⁻⁸ M. Option C.

subject: Chemistry
question_text: Consider the species: A. BrF₄⁻, B. CH₄, C. IF₄⁺, D. XeF₄, E. XeO₂F₂. Which species are isostructural with SF₄? Choose the correct combination.
solution: SF₄ has a seesaw molecular shape (AX₄E). IF₄⁺ has 5 electron domains around iodine with one lone pair and is seesaw; XeO₂F₂ also has four bonded atoms and one lone pair around Xe, giving a seesaw shape. BrF₄⁻ and XeF₄ are square planar, while CH₄ is tetrahedral. Therefore C and E only, option B.

subject: Chemistry
question_text: Gas A undergoes a change from state X to state Y, absorbing 10 J of heat while 18 J of work is done by the gas. Gas A is brought back from Y to X by another process during which 6 J of heat is evolved. In the reverse process Y to X, which statement is correct?
options: 18 J of work is done by the gas A
2 J of work is done by the gas A
12 J of work is done on gas A by the surroundings
14 J of work is done on gas A by the surroundings
solution: For X→Y, ΔU=Q−W=10−18=−8 J. Hence for Y→X, ΔU=+8 J. The reverse process releases 6 J, so Q=−6 J. From ΔU=Q−W, 8=−6−W, giving W=−14 J: 14 J of work is done on the gas by the surroundings. Option D.

subject: Chemistry
question_text: Solution A is prepared by dissolving 1 g of a protein (molar mass 50000 g mol⁻¹) in 0.5 L of water at 300 K; its osmotic pressure is x bar. Solution B is prepared by dissolving 2 g of the same protein in 1 L of water at 300 K; its osmotic pressure is y bar. The entire solution A is mixed with the entire solution B at the same temperature and the resultant osmotic pressure is z bar. Given R=0.083 L bar mol⁻¹ K⁻¹, find x, y and z.
solution: π=(n/V)RT. For A, n=1/50000 mol and V=0.5 L, so concentration=4×10⁻⁵ mol L⁻¹. For B, n=2/50000 mol and V=1 L, giving the same concentration. Thus x=y=(4×10⁻⁵)(0.083)(300)=9.96×10⁻⁴ bar. After mixing, total moles are 6×10⁻⁵ and total volume is 1.5 L, again giving 4×10⁻⁵ M, so z is the same. Option B.

subject: Chemistry
question_text: At 25°C, 20.0 mL of 0.2 M weak acid HX is titrated against 0.2 M NaOH. Ka=5×10⁻⁴, pKa=3.3 and α≪1. The pH at the start of titration (a) and when 10 mL of NaOH has been added (b), respectively, are:
solution: Initially, [H⁺]≈√(KaC)=√(5×10⁻⁴×0.2)=0.01 M, so pH≈2.0. Adding 10 mL of 0.2 M NaOH neutralizes half of the initial acid; this is the half-equivalence point, where pH=pKa=3.3. Option B.

subject: Chemistry
question_text: For the reaction aX → bY, the rate constant at 30°C is 1×10⁻³ L mol⁻¹ s⁻¹. Which statements are true? A. When [X] is increased fourfold, the rate becomes 16 times. B. The reaction is second order. C. The half-life is independent of [X]. D. Decomposition of N₂O₅ is an example of this reaction. E. A plot of ln([R₀]/[R]) against time is a straight line. Choose the correct answer.
solution: The units L mol⁻¹ s⁻¹ identify a second-order reaction. Its rate is proportional to [X]², so quadrupling [X] multiplies the rate by 16 (A true, B true). For a second-order reaction, half-life depends on initial concentration (C false); N₂O₅ decomposition is first order (D false); the logarithmic integrated plot in E is characteristic of first-order kinetics (E false). Therefore A and B only, option A.
